cases.sentence: Авия вступил в сражение с войском из четырехсот тысяч ___, а Иеровоам выстроил против него восемьсот тысяч человек — отборных храбрецов.
cases.explain: «отборных воинов» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men; and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.

cases.sentence: Авия вступил в сражение с войском из четырехсот тысяч отборных воинов, а Иеровоам выстроил против него восемьсот тысяч человек — ___.
cases.explain: «отборных храбрецов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men; and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.

cases.sentence: Но разве вы не изгнали священников Господа — потомков Аарона, а также левитов, и не поставили своих священников по примеру народов ___?
cases.explain: «других земель» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Haven’t you driven out the priests of Yahweh, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made priests for yourselves according to the ways of the peoples of other lands? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may be a priest of those who are no gods.

cases.sentence: Они кладут хлеб на ___ и каждый вечер зажигают светильники на золотых подсвечниках.
cases.explain: «чистый стол» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: and they burn to Yahweh every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense. They also set the show bread in order on the pure table; and the lamp stand of gold with its lamps, to burn every evening; for we keep the instruction of Yahweh our God, but you have forsaken him.

cases.sentence: Они кладут хлеб на чистый стол и каждый вечер зажигают светильники на ___.
cases.explain: «золотых подсвечниках» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: and they burn to Yahweh every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense. They also set the show bread in order on the pure table; and the lamp stand of gold with its lamps, to burn every evening; for we keep the instruction of Yahweh our God, but you have forsaken him.

cases.sentence: Авия и его люди нанесли им тяжелые потери, так что у израильтян пало пятьсот тысяч ___.
cases.explain: «отборных воинов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter, so five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell down slain.

cases.sentence: Авия преследовал Иеровоама и взял у него города Вефиль, Иешану и Эфрон с их ___.
cases.explain: «окрестными поселениями» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephron with its villages.

cases.sentence: ___ правления Авии, сделанное и сказанное им, записаны в истории пророка Иддо.
cases.explain: «Прочие события» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways, and his sayings are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.
